notes.content:
- Fixed an issue introduced in 1.2 that stopped achievements from working.

notes.title: DepowerBall 1.2 Patch Notes - June 3, 2024
notes.content:
Changes:

[list]
[*] Party Mode fixes - a bunch of fixes applied for other platforms had not yet been deployed to Steam, and now they are so things should be much smoother and easier to join up with friends and play!
[*] Brand new railgun visuals!!!
[*] Fixed an input buffer bug that caused players to auto fire at the beginning of a round
[*] Fixed an input buffer bug that affected local menu selections between scenes
[*] Fixed minor UI issues on the main screen
[*] Created new initial loading screen to correspond with major backend changes in preparation for 2.0
[*] Minor matchmaking fix
[/list]

notes.title: Feb 17, 2024 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Only a couple of updates to talk about.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bunch of edge cases in our bots. They should be getting stuck a lot less and make their jumps most of the damn time. We can call this 'Bot 1.5' I guess but it's a damn marked improvement! Hope you enjoy!
[*] Also fixed a melee attack bug in our bots so they should be attacking you a lot more frequently without an offensive power.
[*] Platform changes in the local Throne Room level. 
[/list]

notes.title: Feb 11 Patch Notes!

notes.title: November 22nd Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changing description titles to address the date of the patch instead! Sometimes when I build I skip more than one version that doesn't get pushed out. The version will be added in the notes itself.

[b]Version: [/b]1.0.63

[b]Changes: [/b]
- Added notifications for private matches! Did a complete overhaul of the party system to include backend code for lobbies. Users will now be notified when they are invited to a match with a notification symbol on the title screen as well as a banner that flashes in real time.
- Minor bug fixes

If you spot any bugs as a result of this let me know and I'll snuff em out in the next update! Thanks!

notes.title: DepowerBall Demo Update - Feb 13, 2023
notes.content:
The 'Two events in one week so let's fix as many bugs as we can' update!

The name speaks for itself. There are a bunch of new bug fixes applied to help make your gameplay experience smoother, plus some other fun goodies sprinkled in. Fixes include:

- Fixed some AI cases where they would get stalled (still happens but hopefully not as frequently).
- Fixed some Pause Menu issues.
- Fixed a use case where games ended early and powers didn't activate in subsequent games.
- Fixed a case where sudden death spawns didn't trigger properly in online matches.
- Fixed a bunch of Party UI issues to make the experience from game-to-game more seamless.
- Included the first iteration of Character Summaries to show who is who going into a match.

If you catch any new or persistent bugs, please don't hesitate to report them in the forums or shoot us an email!

Servers will go live at 5PM EST ON February 13th to coincide with the events!

notes.title: DepowerBall - Welcome to The Pit
notes.content:
DepowerBall is a competitive party platformer where the fate of every matchup is influenced by fast-paced gameplay and tactical decision-making.

Every match, each player starts with the same set of powers to try and accomplish their task of pleasing the Dragon Queen by feeding her delicious treats! When a player wins a round, he or she will earn the Queen’s favour, but will earn the wrath of the other players as they vote to take away one of the winner’s powers! Get ready to screw with your friends as you take away the powers they hold most dear and hilariously watch how they deal with the consequences!

In the world of Depowerball, you will need to adapt to the changing conditions, or get left behind as the other players take advantage of your weakened state!

Welcome to the pit.

notes.title: DepowerBall - A Primer
notes.content:
[h1]EDIT: Steam Broadcasting is not allowing the stream to show up on the page, so we're going to be broadcsting from twitch.tv/megapower_games[/h1]

What happens when the Lazor you love is taken right out from underneath you? Or when the Shield that is protecting you all along is now gone, leaving you vulnerable. Join us as the developers of 'DepowerBall' take you through the inner workings of 'The Pit' and teach you some tips and tricks to survive the world of DepowerBall!
